verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an 'update' operation exists (CLI and API can update/delete memories) and webhooks fire on update events, implying the system does modify stored memories over time, but there is no explicit documentation describing automatic contradiction detection, superseding, or merging logic when new facts conflict with old ones. missing for 10: explicit description of conflict/contradiction detection, merge algorithm details, and independent hands-on evidence that Mem0 correctly resolves contradictory facts.
